name: Corpus Callosum Agenesis-Macrocephaly-Hypertelorism Syndrome

criteria.description: Complete or partial agenesis of the corpus callosum confirmed by neuroimaging
Macrocephaly defined as head circumference >2 standard deviations above mean for age and sex
Increased interorbital distance (hypertelorism) confirmed by clinical examination or imaging
Global developmental delay or intellectual disability
Additional facial dysmorphic features such as broad nasal bridge or prominent forehead

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of all three major criteria: agenesis of corpus callosum, macrocephaly, and hypertelorism
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis is primarily clinical supported by neuroimaging; genetic testing may assist in differential diagnosis

imaging: MRI or CT demonstrating complete or partial agenesis of the corpus callosum
Neuroimaging showing ventriculomegaly or hydrocephalus in rare cases
genetic: No specific gene identified; genetic testing may exclude other syndromes with overlapping features
other: Clinical examination revealing macrocephaly and characteristic facial dysmorphisms

distinguishingFeatures: Variable associated anomalies depending on etiology
Craniosynostosis with hypertelorism but normal corpus callosum
Corpus callosum agenesis with polydactyly and facial anomalies

redFlags: Rapidly increasing head circumference suggestive of hydrocephalus
